youtube_metadata.title: Meta & Stripe Launch Personal Agent Protocol for AI Commerce #Shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
Meta and Sierra have unveiled the Personal Agent Protocol (PAP) built on OAuth. Backed by Walmart, Shopify, and Stripe, it replaces chaotic scraping with verified token handshakes.
